dedupe_keys.name: hifld open federal emergency management agency fema regional offices

description: HIFLD Open Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Regional Offices is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (Federal Emergency Management Agency et al.). Regional Headquarters Offices manage, operate and maintain all delegated programs, functions and activities not managed, operated or maintained by headquarters organizational units. The FEMA Regional Offices serve as the primary organizational unit for liaison to states and local governments within each region, and non-governmental and private sector entities within each Regional Office's geographical area. Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
